svg.desc: Aligned heatmaps follow 2,883 exons through two mouse cortical age series. Median late-minus-early inclusion is about +0.21 and +0.19 for M2 and close to zero for M3. In the latest age bin, the three sensory receptor samples score at cortical stage 1, while all five ganglion and four central neuron samples score at stage 6.
